subject: Observability add-ons: onboarding credit & SKU bundling request
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acme.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — onboarding credit & SKU bundling request

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme's questions around retention and tracing granularity were really helpful — I looped Ben on pricing so we can give you a clear commercial path. A couple of asks from your side I wanted to confirm in one place: 

- You wanted a single SKU that bundles long-tail storage for traces + advanced dashboards (monthly slab) rather than separate per-GB metering.
- You asked whether we can include a one-time onboarding credit to offset the first-month ingestion spike while you finish dataset tuning.

Ben, can you share a pricing worksheet and a suggested credit structure we could propose to Alex? Alex — if you can confirm target retention (hot retain for 30 days, cold archive 12 months) and an expected ingest profile (avg daily GB), that will help us size the proposal.

Thanks,

Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none in this message]
From: Alex Johnson <alex@acme.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — onboarding credit & SKU bundling request

Irene — thanks. Confirming the retention plan: hot: 30 days at full fidelity, cold: 12 months compressed (traces indexed but not full span retention). We expect an initial ingest burst as we onboard historical traces: approx 6 TB over the first 14 days, then steady-state ~200 GB/day.

Two commercial clarifications we need before procurement:
1) Will the onboarding credit be a dollar credit on month 1 or a token/GB credit applied to ingestion?
2) If we commit to a 12-month term and a spend floor ($60k/mo), what level of discount or onboarding credit can Redwood offer for the observability bundle (retention + dashboards + tracing sampling)?

Also: can you provide an SOW draft and any SLA language around trace retrieval (RTO for archived traces)? Sending procurement (contracts@acme.ai) in copy.

— Alex
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acme.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — onboarding credit & SKU bundling request

Alex — thanks for the details, this is helpful. Attached is a pricing worksheet (obs-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW (SOW-draft-acme.pdf). High-level proposal below: 

- Offer: Observability Bundle SKU (dashboard seats + tracing retain) with monthly slab for archival storage.
- Commitment: 12 months, $60k/mo minimum commitment.
- Discounting: 18% off list for the bundle at this commit level (applies to tokens + retention slab).
- Onboarding credit: one-time $15k credit applied as invoice credit in month 1 to absorb the historical ingest spike.
- SLA note: Standard retention retrieval target — 99th percentile retrieval for archived traces within 24 hours; expedited retrieval options available as an add-on.

Alternative: If Acme prefers a consumption-first path, we can offer a 6-month pilot with a smaller onboarding credit ($8k) and re-evaluate commit once steady-state is observed.

Jordan — can you confirm whether the 24-hour retrieval RTO above is acceptable from an operations standpoint, and whether we should propose an expedited retrieval SLA (SLP) with a priced per-request fee?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: obs-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: SOW-draft-acme.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Alex Johnson <alex@acme.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acme.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — onboarding credit & SKU bundling request

Ben / Irene — appreciate the quick turnaround and the worksheet. Procurement will prefer a dollar credit applied on invoice (simple for accounting). A few follow-ups from our side: 

- The $15k onboarding credit sounds reasonable if we proceed with the 12-month commit. Please add language in the SOW that it will be applied as an invoice credit against month 1 charges.
- The 24-hour RTO is OK for now; please include the optional expedited retrieval pricing in the SOW so we can evaluate.
- Can you also add a brief example line-item in the worksheet showing how the first-month invoice would look with the credit applied (ingest spike + credit = net due)? That will make approval faster.

If you can send an updated SOW with those clarifications and a DocuSign link, procurement can start review today.

— Alex
Director, Platform Engineering, Acme.ai
[Forwarded quote: see attachments]
